ethical_and_operational_invariants.no_forced_interventions: Field personnel and test operators SHALL NOT artificially induce abrupt braking or aggressive swerving near real workers.
ethical_and_operational_invariants.no_worker_deception: Naturalistic capture observes normal warehouse workflows without modifying shifts, incentives, or worker movement patterns.
ethical_and_operational_invariants.passive_monitoring: All instrumentation operates in non-invasive passive monitoring mode. No audio warnings or visual indicators shall alter natural worker psychology.
ethical_and_operational_invariants.safety_priority: Facility operational safety rules and vehicle factory safety systems take absolute precedence over data acquisition.

event_sampling_framework.power_analysis_rationale: Event sample size cannot be arbitrarily set; it must be determined post-pilot after measuring baseline empirical rates of naturalistic swerves and interventions.

nominal_safe_controls.description: Routine traversals without braking or steering deviations (sanity checks for false alarms).
nominal_safe_controls.quota_strategy: Systematic random subsampling of nominal runs

near_miss_stopping_events.description: In-lane decelerations triggered by real operational obstacles without secondary intrusion.
near_miss_stopping_events.quota_strategy: 100% census capture via kinematic threshold trigger

benign_swerve_events.description: Vehicle steering maneuvers bypassing obstacles into demonstrably empty cross-aisles.

secondary_exposure_candidates.description: Vehicle diversion intersecting cross-aisle with observed secondary actor presence.
secondary_exposure_candidates.quota_strategy: 100% census capture with highest priority packaging

independent_actor_confounded.description: Maneuvers occurring coincidentally with unrelated secondary pedestrian movements.

insufficient_observability_rejections.description: Events where vehicle swerves towards unobserved or occluded secondary zones.
insufficient_observability_rejections.quota_strategy: Audit package generation for Gate E4 verification

hardware_sensor_dropouts.description: Natural dropouts or sync failures used to verify pipeline rejection integrity.
hardware_sensor_dropouts.quota_strategy: Audit package generation for Gate C1-C4 verification
